name: AI Infrastructure and Hardware
blurb: GPUs, NPUs, TPUs, chip fabs, memory and storage, plus the datacenters, power, cooling, and networking underneath them.

built.name: GPUs
built.detail: Datacenter and workstation GPUs, by generation, memory, and throughput.

built.name: NPUs and TPUs
built.detail: Purpose-built accelerators outside the GPU line.

built.name: Chip Fabrication
built.detail: This section covers the companies that physically manufacture AI silicon, on which process nodes, and where.

built.name: Memory and Storage
built.detail: This section covers the memory that sits next to the accelerator and the storage tiers that keep it fed.

built.name: Memory Supply
built.detail: Who makes the memory on an AI accelerator, why no index tracks its price, how it drives up PC memory prices, and how HBM4 changes the chip.

built.name: Networking Fabric
built.detail: This section covers the interconnect inside and between training nodes: the scale-up fabric that links GPUs within a rack and the scale-out fabric that links racks into a cluster.
